snippet.title: Stellar Blade X GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE Crossover DLC
snippet.description:
Worlds collide in an epic crossover of heroic proportions in this add-on expansion for Stellar Blade featuring GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE.

Reclaim Earth for Humankind in Stellar Blade™

Coming to PC on June 11 2025 (PST). Pre-purchase now.
